source_refs.note: The experimental design section (printed as a second '22.3', which should be 22.4; PDF 203-204).

blocks.text: When scientists test an idea they plan the experiment carefully; this planning is experimental design. They choose the subjects and control the conditions so the results are fair, then change one thing, the independent variable, and see how it affects another, the dependent variable, to find out whether their hypothesis is right or wrong.
